research: R214 H4 three-bar impulse exhaustion + confirmed structure reversal
run_type: local Python execution; no new Actions backtest launched

rule.long: three prior completed H4 candles bearish with strictly descending closes; current completed H4 candle bullish and closes above prior H4 high
rule.short: three prior completed H4 candles bullish with strictly ascending closes; current completed H4 candle bearish and closes below prior H4 low
rule.entry: first non-flat M5 BID open >= signal H4 close + 5m and strictly before next scheduled H4 close
rule.stop: signal H4 low for long; signal H4 high for short
rule.execution: BID M5 OHLC; SL before TP; stop gap at available open; skip synthetic flat bars; no forward-fill; one position per instrument
rule.costs: modeled round-trip entry price costs of 1bp and 2bp, not measured broker costs
rule.selection: discovery eligibility >=30 closed and PF@2bp >=1.00; among eligible pick fewest trades then highest PF@2bp; never replace based on forward

limitations: BID-only source; no historical ASK stream
